messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine_to_five>
Required: between 9 and 5 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_seven>
Backend engineering: 7 years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Let us discuss any ambiguities or mistakes in the requirement before
proceeding with the assessment.

response.text:
**Ambiguity in the requirement.** “Between 9 and 5 years” reverses the usual order. In ordinary English, “between A and B” is the span with those two numbers as endpoints, so 5 through 9 is the same set either way. It is not “at least 9 and at most 5,” which would be an empty, impossible constraint. Inclusivity is unstated, but that does not matter here: 7 sits strictly inside either reading of the endpoints.

**Assessment.** On that reading, the candidate matches. The summary states 7 years of backend engineering, which falls inside 5–9 years. The posting, as written, does not add stack, domain, or seniority constraints, so those details in the summary are irrelevant to the match.
